response.hazard_agreement_note: Share of the real traverse our map classes as safe or caution for rover_scout (no-go >= 20 deg). Higher supports the hazard map.
response.route_realism_note: Planned vs actually driven length between consecutive real waypoints. Ratios below 1 mean our planner found a shorter path the rover did not take, often because real drives detour for science and rocks below DEM resolution.
